notes.title: UI updated.
notes.content:
1. Game UI updated and will be updated continuously. And also preparing Level, Skill tree and Item system.

2. You can switch between WASD(or direction key) move and mouse click move in a game.

notes.title: Multiplay map support
notes.content: 1.0.2 Map selection are added in multiplay option and one more skill updated.

notes.title: 1.0.1 update
notes.content:
1.0.1 update : Large modern third map update for single play. There are 3 simple acts and each consists of a map. And There was some balancing.
I'm planning to update some more attack skills on next update. This game is in developing.
